title: Install the app
link: Install Fakturist on your phone or computer
lead: Put Fakturist on the home screen of your phone, tablet or computer: it opens with one tap, in its own window, without the browser bars.
installed: You are already using the installed app.
ready: This browser can install it right away.
done: The app is installed: you will find it on the home screen or among the computer's applications.
iosNote: On iPhone and iPad there is no install button: Apple allows it only from the Share menu. Three taps are enough.
samsungNote: From Samsung Internet the app is installed in a way that Android marks as unsafe. Install it from Chrome: it is the same app, without warnings.
samsungInstalled: If you have already installed it from Samsung Internet, remove it from the home screen and install it again from Chrome.

android.title: Android
android.s1: Open Fakturist in Chrome (recommended) or Edge.
android.s2: Tap the ⋮ menu at the top right.
android.s3: Tap “Install app” or “Add to Home screen” and confirm.
android.s4: The Fakturist icon is among your apps and opens in its own window.

ios.title: iPhone and iPad
ios.s1: Open Fakturist in Safari (from iOS 16.4 also in Chrome or Edge).
ios.s2: Tap Share — the square with the arrow pointing up.
ios.s3: Scroll and tap “Add to Home Screen”.
ios.s4: If there is an “Open as Web App” option, leave it on and tap “Add”.

pc.title: Computer with Chrome or Edge (Windows, Mac, Linux)
pc.s1: Use the “Install the app” button above, when it is there.
pc.s2: Or click the install icon on the right of the address bar (a screen with an arrow).
pc.s3: Confirm with “Install”: Fakturist opens in its own window and stays in the Start menu, the Dock or among your applications.
pc.s4: The desktop icon appears by itself or from the window's menu.

mac.title: Mac with Safari
mac.s1: Open Fakturist in Safari (macOS Sonoma or later).
mac.s2: From the File menu choose “Add to Dock”.
mac.s3: Fakturist opens from the Dock in its own window, without the Safari bars.

firefox: Firefox on a computer does not install web apps: use Chrome, Edge or Safari on a Mac. On Android Firefox installs it from the ⋮ menu.
why1: One tap from the home screen or the desktop, like your other apps.
why2: More room for the invoice: no address bar and tabs.
why3: Always the latest version: it is Fakturist itself, there is nothing to update.
why4: Documents stay on the server, not on the phone: without a network the app says so and waits.
